subject: MSA redline review + onboarding checkpoint
messages:
From: Megan Torres <megan.torres@novushealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novushealth.com, legal@novushealth.com
Date: 2026-09-20T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Request: MSA redline review + onboarding checkpoint

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Legal and procurement at Novus would like to run a focused redline session for the MSA and then a short onboarding checkpoint to align on SSO, data residency, and the initial pilot plan. Can you propose 60-minute windows the week of Sept 26?

Attendees we expect: Megan Torres (procurement), Priya Shah (legal), and our PM (Carlos Reyes). If possible, include a Redwood legal/contract SME + a PM and someone who can speak to Dedicated/Private deployment options.

I've attached our current redlines (Novus_MSA_redlines_v2.docx) — please confirm you've got it and whether we should pre-share anything else.

Best,
Megan
Megan Torres
Director, Sourcing & Procurement
Novus Health

Attachment: Novus_MSA_redlines_v2.docx (document stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Megan Torres <megan.torres@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: MSA redline review + onboarding checkpoint

Hi Megan — thanks for sending this over and for the clear attendee list. We can run a 60-minute session; here are a couple options (all times PT):

- Tues, Sept 28 — 2:00pm–3:00pm PT
- Wed, Sept 29 — 11:00am–12:00pm PT

Laura (legal) and Marissa (customer ops) are CC'd — either slot works for us but flagging that Laura has a late meeting on the 28th and might need to join at 2:15 if we pick that day.

We can prepare a 15-minute pre-read summarizing the redline asks we see today and a proposed carveout matrix for data residency. I'll also attach our onboarding plan so your PM can review ahead.

If you confirm a preferred slot I'll send a calendar invite and an agenda.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_Onboarding_Plan.pdf (document stub)

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: MSA redline review + onboarding checkpoint

Hi all — quick note from legal. I can join either slot but the 28th is tight on my side; if we pick Tues 2:00pm PT I may need a 15-minute delay. If Novus legal prefers a 3:00pm PT start that would be easier for me.

Also: it would be helpful to get the Novus redlines converted to a compare doc (tracked changes or summary of top 7 asks) so we can triage quickly in the call. If your team can send that, Laura can prioritize items.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com

Thanks, Soojin and Laura. Procurement can hold Tues Sept 28 at 2:00pm PT, but Priya (legal) is out until late afternoon and would prefer a 3:00pm PT start so she can dial in. Is 3:00pm PT acceptable for Redwood? If yes we can lock it and I'll send a calendar invite.

Also attaching a one-page summary of Novus top risks (Novus_Risk_Summary_Sept2026.pdf) so you have context.

Best,
Megan

Hi Megan — 3:00pm PT on Tues Sept 28 works for Redwood; locking it now. Calendar invite sent (see link below). We'll set a focused 60-minute agenda: 15 min triage/top asks, 30 min redline walk, 15 min onboarding next-steps.

Dial-in / meeting link: https://meet.redwood.com/novus-msa-20260928 (placeholder)
Pre-reads: I've attached our onboarding plan and will circulate a short compare doc by EOD Monday. Laura — can you prioritize the likely stickier clauses (data residency, liability caps, audit rights) so we can go straight to resolution?

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the sync.

Best,
Soojin

Attachment: Redwood_Onboarding_Plan.pdf (document stub)

- Redwood: Laura to send a prioritized clause list; Soojin/Marissa to provide onboarding checklist.
